name: PriceChangeBatchManager
tagline: Every price change on the shelf on time – printed, put up, scanned and signed off, without overcharging a customer.
description: A complete store price-change module for supermarkets, pharmacies and retail chains: head-office price change batches broken into lines, a shelf-edge label print queue with a print window and real label previews, labelling rules that keep shelf and till in step, a store walk in aisle order for the shop floor, scan verification of the till and shelf price with automatic exceptions, exception resolution and batch sign-off by the store manager – with associate, pricing supervisor and store manager roles. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Head-office batches (permanent, promotion start / end, markdown, price match) broken into lines
Print window and print-job CSV for the label printer
Shelf-edge label preview with was price, unit price and offer end
Overcharge rule: decreases never before the effective date, increases up on time
Store walk in aisle order with big buttons for handhelds
Scan verification of till and shelf price with tolerance and a separate verifier
Automatic exceptions and resolution (reprint, relabel, till corrected, delisted)
Batch progress, report and store-manager sign-off
Large-change check against the price file
Roles: store associate, pricing supervisor, store manager
KPIs: due today, overdue, overcharge risk, price integrity %
Power Fx outputs and events (PrintJobText, ReportText, SummaryJson)
